question: On plain 4% up days, does pre-move range tightness (tightness = 5d range pct-rank, LOW=tight) grade the day? Expect LOW tightness (tighter range before the move) = better stop-R, per Darvas-box/VCP logic that tight coiling precedes the best expansions.
plain: Darvas box idea: a stock that was trading in a very tight, narrow range right before a 4% up day should have a better follow-through than one that was already choppy and wide-ranging.
